'''Chisa Yūki''' (Japanese: '''優希知冴''' ''Yūki Chisa'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Yūki was born on August 19, 1989 in {{wp|Osaka Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became voice actress as an adult. She began her work during the {{aniseries|SM}}, where her only role was [[Kahili]], one of the [[Elite Four]]. Yūki is currently affiliated with talent agency [http://kenyu-office.com Kenyuu Office].
